units.en: Envoys to foreign courts reported that foreign rulers always asked Du's age, whom he resembled, and whether the Son of Heaven still employed him.
units.literal: Envoys to foreign states: their rulers were sure to ask Du's age now, whose appearance he most resembled, and whether the Son of Heaven employed him.

units.zh: 其威譽德業比郭汾陽，而用不用常為天下重輕。
units.en: His prestige and achievement were compared to Guo Ziyi of Fenyang, and whether he held office often weighed on the fortunes of the realm.
units.literal: His awesomeness, reputation, virtue, and achievement were compared to Guo Ziyi of Fenyang, and whether he was used or not often made the realm heavy or light.

units.zh: 事四朝，以全德始終。
units.en: He served four reigns and preserved his integrity to the end.
units.literal: He served four reigns, with complete virtue from beginning to end.

units.zh: 及歿，天下莫不思其風烈。
units.en: At his death the realm mourned his noble spirit.
units.literal: When he died, none under Heaven did not think of his wind and fierceness.

units.zh: 葬管城，逮今廟食。
units.en: He was buried at Guancheng, where he is honored in temple rites to this day.
units.literal: He was buried at Guancheng; down to today he receives temple offerings.

units.zh: 五子，識、諗知名。
units.en: He had five sons, of whom Shi and Shen were the best known.
units.literal: He had five sons; Shi and Shen were well known.

units.zh: 子 識
units.en: His son Shi
units.literal: Son: Shi

units.zh: 識，字通理，性敏悟，凡經目未始忘。
units.en: Shi, styled Tongli, was quick-witted and never forgot anything he read.
units.literal: Shi, courtesy name Tongli, was by nature keen and perceptive; whatever passed his eyes he never forgot.

units.zh: 推廕補京兆參軍，擢累大理少卿。
units.en: Through hereditary privilege he entered service as a Capital staff officer and rose to vice minister of the Court of Judicial Review.
units.literal: Through hereditary privilege he was supplemented as staff officer of the capital metropolis, was selected and repeatedly promoted to vice minister of the Court of Judicial Review.

units.zh: 王師討劉稹，為供軍使。
units.en: When the court campaigned against Liu Zhen, he served as army supply commissioner.
units.literal: When the imperial army campaigned against Liu Zhen, he was supply commissioner.

units.zh: 稹平，改司農卿，進湖南觀察使。
units.en: After Zhen fell he was made Minister of Agriculture, then Hunan governor.
units.literal: When Zhen was pacified, he was changed to Minister of Agriculture and advanced to Hunan observation commissioner.

units.zh: 入拜大理卿，襲晉國公半封。
units.en: He returned to court as chief of the Court of Judicial Review and inherited half his father's enfeoffment as Duke of Jin.
units.literal: He entered court as chief of the Court of Judicial Review and inherited half the enfeoffment of Duke of Jin.

units.zh: 為涇原節度使。
units.en: He was appointed military commissioner of Jingyuan.
units.literal: He was made military commissioner of Jingyuan.

units.zh: 時蕃酋尚恐熱上三州七關，列屯分守。
units.en: The Tibetan chieftain Shang Kongre had surrendered three prefectures and seven passes, which were garrisoned in separate camps.
units.literal: At that time the Tibetan chieftain Shang Kongre presented the three prefectures and seven passes; they set up camps in array to guard separately.

units.zh: 宣宗擇名臣，以識帥涇原，畢諴帥邠甯，李福帥夏州，帝親臨遣。
units.en: Emperor Xuanzong chose renowned ministers: Shi to command Jingyuan, Bi Dan to command Bin-Ning, and Li Fu to command Xiazhou, and saw them off in person.
units.literal: Emperor Xuanzong chose renowned ministers: Shi to command Jingyuan, Bi Dan to command Bin-Ning, Li Fu to command Xiazhou—the emperor personally saw them off on dispatch.

units.zh: 識至，治堡障，整戎器，開屯田。
units.en: On arrival Shi repaired fortifications, reorganized weapons, and opened military colonies.
units.literal: When Shi arrived, he repaired fortifications, put in order weapons, and opened military colonies.

units.zh: 初，將士守邊，或積歲不得還。
units.en: Previously border troops sometimes served for years without rotation.
units.literal: At first soldiers guarding the border sometimes could not return for accumulated years.

units.zh: 識與立戍限，滿者代；
units.en: Shi set terms of service: when a tour was complete, men were replaced;
units.literal: Shi established garrison term limits—when a tour was complete, replace;

units.zh: 親七十，近戍。
units.en: if a soldier's parents were seventy, he was posted nearby.
units.literal: if parents were seventy, garrison nearby.

units.zh: 由是人感悅。
units.en: The troops were deeply grateful.
units.literal: From this the men were moved and pleased.

units.zh: 加檢校刑部尚書，徙鳳翔、忠武、天平、邠甯、靈武等軍。
units.en: He was made acting Minister of Justice and served in turn at Fengxiang, Zhongwu, Tianping, Bin-Ning, Lingwu, and other commands.
units.literal: He was made acting Minister of Justice and transferred through the armies of Fengxiang, Zhongwu, Tianping, Bin-Ning, Lingwu, and others.

units.zh: 進檢校尚書右僕射。
units.en: He was promoted to acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: He was advanced to acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 靈武地斥鹵無井，識誓神而鑿之，果得泉。
units.en: Lingwu's land was brackish and without wells. Shi vowed to the spirits, drilled, and found a spring.
units.literal: Lingwu's land was saline without wells; Shi vowed to the spirits and drilled, and indeed obtained a spring.

units.zh: 曆六節度，所蒞皆有可述。
units.en: He held six military commissions, and in each left accomplishments worth recounting.
units.literal: He passed through six military commissions; wherever he presided there was something to recount.

units.zh: 卒，贈司空，諡曰昭。
units.en: At his death he was posthumously made Minister of Works with the posthumous name Zhao.
units.literal: On his death he was posthumously made Minister of Works, posthumous name Zhao.

units.zh: 子 諗
units.en: His son Shen
units.literal: Son: Shen

units.zh: 諗有文，籍廕累官考功員外郎。
units.en: Shen was a gifted writer who rose through privilege to outer vice director in the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: Shen had literary talent; through registry privilege he accumulated offices to outer vice director of the Ministry of Personnel for merit evaluation.

units.zh: 宣宗訪元和宰相子，思度勳望，故待諗有加。
units.en: Emperor Xuanzong inquired after the sons of Yuanhe chief ministers and, remembering Du's merit, treated Shen with special favor.
units.literal: Emperor Xuanzong inquired after the sons of Yuanhe chief ministers, thought of Du's merit and stature, and therefore treated Shen with extra favor.

units.zh: 為翰林學士，累遷工部侍郎，詔加承旨。
units.en: He became a Hanlin academician, rose to vice minister of public works, and was made chief academician by edict.
units.literal: He was made Hanlin academician, was repeatedly promoted to vice minister of public works, and by edict was made chief academician.

units.zh: 適會帝幸其院，諗即稱謝。
units.en: When the emperor visited the Hanlin institute, Shen thanked him at once.
units.literal: It happened that the emperor visited his institute; Shen at once offered thanks.

units.zh: 帝曰：「可歸與妻子相慶。」
units.en: The emperor said, "Go home and celebrate with your wife and children."
units.literal: The emperor said: "You may return and celebrate with wife and children."

units.zh: 取禦奩果以賜，諗舉衣跽受。
units.en: He gave him fruit from the imperial casket. Shen raised his robe and knelt to receive it.
units.literal: He took imperial casket fruit to bestow; Shen raised his robe and knelt to receive.

units.zh: 帝顧宮人取巾裹賜之。
units.en: The emperor had a palace woman bring a cloth wrapper for the gift.
units.literal: The emperor turned to palace women to take a cloth wrapper and bestow it on him.

units.zh: 後為太子少師，封河東郡公。
units.en: Later he was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and enfeoffed as Duke of Hedong.
units.literal: Later he was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and enfeoffed as Duke of Hedong commandery.

units.zh: 黃巢盜國，迫以偽官，不從，遇害。
units.en: When Huang Chao seized power, Shen was offered a rebel post. He refused and was killed.
units.literal: When Huang Chao usurped the state, he was compelled with a false office; he did not obey and was killed.

units.zh: 贊曰：憲宗討蔡，出入四年。
units.en: The commentator says: Emperor Xianzong's campaign against Cai lasted four years from start to finish.
units.literal: The encomium says: Xianzong's campaign against Cai went in and out for four years.

units.zh: 元濟外連奸臣，刺宰相及用事者，沮駭朝謀。
units.en: Yuanji allied with treacherous ministers at court, had chief ministers and power-holders assassinated, and paralyzed the throne's strategy.
units.literal: Yuanji externally linked with treacherous ministers, assassinated chief ministers and those in power, and frustrated and terrified court plans.

units.zh: 惟天子赫然排群議，任度政事，倚以討賊。
units.en: Only the emperor boldly overrode the multitude of counsels, entrusted Du with government, and relied on him to crush the rebels.
units.literal: Only the Son of Heaven awesomely brushed aside the multitude of opinions, entrusted Du with government affairs, and relied on him to campaign against the rebels.

units.zh: 身督戰，遂平淮西。
units.en: Du took command in person and pacified Huai West.
units.literal: He personally supervised the campaign and thereby pacified Huai West.

units.zh: 非度破賊之難，任度之為難也。
units.en: It was not Du's defeating the rebels that was difficult—it was entrusting Du that was difficult.
units.literal: It was not Du's breaking the rebels that was difficult—it was entrusting Du that was difficult.

units.zh: 韓愈頌其功曰：「凡此蔡功，惟斷乃成。」
units.en: Han Yu praised his achievement in verse: "All this victory over Cai was won only through resolute decision."
units.literal: Han Yu praised his achievement, saying: "All this achievement over Cai was accomplished only through resolute decision."

units.zh: 其知言哉！
units.en: How rightly he spoke!
units.literal: How well he spoke!

units.zh: 穆宗不君，憸人腐夫乘釁鐫詆，而度遂無顯功。
units.en: Muzong did not rule as a true sovereign. Treacherous and corrupt men seized their chance to slander Du, and he won no further conspicuous victories.
units.literal: Muzong did not rule as a true sovereign; treacherous men and rotten fellows seized the opening to carve and slander, and Du therefore had no conspicuous achievement.

units.zh: 非前智後愚，用不用，勢當然矣。
units.en: This was not wisdom in one reign and folly in another, nor use versus neglect—it was simply the way circumstances had to be.
units.literal: It was not wisdom before and folly after, or use and non-use—the momentum was necessarily so.

units.zh: 前史稱度晚節頗浮沉為自安計，是不然。
units.en: Earlier histories say Du's later years were marked by drift and self-preservation. That is not so.
units.literal: Earlier histories say Du's later years were rather adrift and floating as a plan for self-preservation—that is not so.

units.zh: 《大雅》曰：「既明且哲，以保其身。」
units.en: The Greater Odes say, "Bright and wise, he thereby preserved himself."
units.literal: The Greater Odes say: "Both bright and wise, thereby preserving one's person."

units.zh: 度何訿雲。
units.en: How could Du be faulted for that?
units.literal: How could Du be faulted for this?
